name: Tears Of Benaco
source:
A new experience in an expensive Italian university located in Borgo Benaco: a beautiful picturesque town by the shores of Lago di Garda, in the Lombardia region.

Six guys with twisted pasts, a murder,  a peaceful place turned into a hunting ground,  all while time ticks away waiting to reveal who the winner will be: who will die and who will live.

Somebody arrived, somebody died, somebody ran away, somebody stayed, somebody watched... and that somebody is still WATCHING.

[From [url=https://cobysaurus.itch.io/tears-of-benaco-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
